title: TP-Link Kasa cameras leaked home GPS via unauthenticated UDP for 6 years
summary: Security researchers discovered that TP-Link Kasa EC71 cameras leaked users' home GPS coordinates via unauthenticated UDP protocol for approximately 6 years, allowing potential attackers to track victim locations without any credentials or authentication.
problem_solved: Exposes a critical privacy vulnerability in consumer IoT devices that allowed unauthenticated location tracking of users' home addresses.
why_valuable: This research highlights a severe security flaw in widely-used smart home cameras that could enable stalking, burglary planning, or surveillance, demonstrating the ongoing privacy risks in consumer IoT devices.
